第2227章天差地别
洛千凝成功借此机缘，登上仙王境。
虽说前路依旧忐忑，困难重重，但当数千年后夫妻重聚，陈凡和洛千凝都忍不住问起了他们各自仙途当中所遇之事与所识之人。
洛千凝独自一人在万仙岭中闯荡，形单影只，几乎不曾与他人有多少交集，她所有的时间全都是按照前世所得经验，以最快的速度提升自己的修为。
而陈凡就不一样了，在飞升仙界的百年间，陈凡经历了太多的大风大浪，生离死别。
每当回首往事时，对于陈凡来说，最难接受的便是登仙阁的覆灭。
洛千凝安抚丈夫失落自责的情绪，听闻登仙阁内有陈凡的两个恩人尚且存活，她马上便要求去对方见一面。
当陈凡与洛千凝出现在剑阁外的弟子所修行的区域，沈梦看到洛千凝的瞬间，整个人都惊呆了。
“这世间竟会有如此美貌之人？！”
沈梦一时间看痴了。
洛千凝之前在剑阁内昏迷的消息，虽然在剑阁内也早已传开，但是除了一些重要成员之外，其他人根本不能靠近。
陈凡和洛千凝飘然落下，许成愚这才推了沈梦一把。
“陈…陈仙师。”沈梦本想直呼其名，但又觉得不妥。
如今的陈凡已经是大罗金仙，别说沈梦自己了，哪怕是许成愚现在与对方比起来，也是云泥之别。
就在沈梦向陈凡行礼问好之后，许成愚也连忙拱手道：“参见陈仙师。”
眼见两人如此拘谨，陈凡赶紧摆摆手，略带不悦的说道：“哎，你们这是干什么？我早说过，无论什么时候，我们都是朋友，你们叫我名字就行了，听见了吗？”
陈凡怕他们不答应，最后专门用近乎命令的语气。
许成愚和沈梦明白，陈凡可不是在责怪他们，之所以这么说，反而是因为内心当中真的把他们当成了朋友。
这一瞬间，二人心中不由涌过一股暖流。
同时也不由佩服，陈凡好像还是从前的那个陈凡，没有因为自身实力和地位的高低，而出现任何的变化。

就凭这一点便已经超越了这世间至少九成以上的强者。
随后，陈凡便将妻子介绍给了二人：“这位就是我的妻子洛千凝。”
他没有多做介绍，因为在剑阁这段时间，虽然沈梦和许成愚身为外阁弟子，无权见到洛千凝本人，但是对于她的各种情况应该早已听说。
果不其然，在陈凡介绍完之后，沈梦和许成愚便对视一眼后，马上同时说道：“见过洛仙子。”
洛千凝淡然一笑，摆手道：“二位不必如此客气，你们既是我夫君朋友，今后便也是我的朋友。”
“我听凡说了，当初他刚刚飞升仙界的时候，便在登仙阁内修行，二位没少照顾他，这份恩情，千凝铭记于心。”
content_en:
Chapter 2227 A world of difference
Luo Qianning successfully took this opportunity to ascend to the Immortal King Realm.
Although the road ahead was still uncertain and full of difficulties, when the couple reunited thousands of years later, Chen Fan and Luo Qianning couldn't help but ask about the things they met and the people they met on their respective immortal paths.
Luo Qianning wandered alone in the Ten Thousand Immortals Ridge, alone, and had almost no interactions with others. She spent all her time improving her cultivation as quickly as possible based on the experience she gained in her previous life.
But Chen Fan was different. During the hundred years of ascending to the immortal world, Chen Fan experienced too many storms, life and death.
Whenever he looks back on the past, the most difficult thing for Chen Fan to accept is the destruction of Dengxian Pavilion.
Luo Qianning appeased her husband's feelings of loss and self-blame. When she heard that two of Chen Fan's benefactors were still alive in Dengxian Pavilion, she immediately asked to see them.
When Chen Fan and Luo Qianning appeared in the area where the disciples were practicing outside the sword pavilion, Shen Meng was stunned when he saw Luo Qianning.
"How could there be such a beautiful person in this world?!"
Shen Meng was fascinated for a while.
Although the news that Luo Qianning was unconscious in the sword pavilion had already spread in the sword pavilion, except for some important members, no one else could get close to him.
Chen Fan and Luo Qianning fell down, and Xu Chengyu pushed Shen Meng.
"Chen...Chen Xianshi." Shen Meng wanted to call him by his first name, but felt it was inappropriate.
Nowadays, Chen Fan is already the Great Luo Jinxian. Not to mention Shen Meng himself, even Xu Chengyu is completely different from him now.
Just after Shen Meng saluted Chen Fan and said hello, Xu Chengyu quickly raised his hands and said, "See Master Chen."
Seeing that the two of them were so reserved, Chen Fan quickly waved his hands and said with a hint of displeasure: "Hey, what are you doing? I've said before that we are friends no matter what, just call me by my name. Do you hear me?"
Chen Fan was afraid that they would not agree, so he used an almost commanding tone in the end.
Xu Chengyu and Shen Meng understood that Chen Fan was not blaming them. The reason why he said this was because he really regarded them as friends in his heart.
At this moment, a warm current surged through their hearts.
At the same time, I couldn't help but admire that Chen Fan seemed to be the same Chen Fan as before, without any changes due to his own strength and status.
With this alone, he has surpassed at least 90% of the powerful people in the world.
Afterwards, Chen Fan introduced his wife to the two of them: "This is my wife Luo Qianning."
He did not introduce much, because during their time in Jiange, although Shen Meng and Xu Chengyu were disciples of the outer pavilion and did not have the right to see Luo Qianning in person, they should have heard about her various situations.
Sure enough, after Chen Fan finished his introduction, Shen Meng and Xu Chengyu looked at each other and immediately said at the same time: "I have met Fairy Luo."
Luo Qianning smiled calmly, waved her hands and said, "You two don't have to be so polite. Since you are my husband's friends, you will also be my friends from now on."
"I heard from Fan that when he first ascended to the Immortal Realm, he practiced in the Dengxian Pavilion. The two of you took good care of him. Qian Ning will remember this kindness in his heart."
